critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the existing engine nacelle primitive to create four total engines; distribute them along the leading edge of the swept wings by moving two outward from the wing root and mirroring them across the fuselage centerline. Scale the nacelles by a factor of 1.2 and rotate them -5 degrees relative to the wing span to form tapered, aerodynamic shapes integrated into pylon primitives.
